narrative.introduction: This domain covers culinary herbs and spices used worldwide as ingredients — organized around how they're used in the kitchen, not botanical taxonomy.
narrative.seo_description: Culinary herbs and spices across four groups: Fresh Herbs, Dried Herbs, Whole Spices, and Ground & Blended Spices.
